body: Reciprocal review ask (resend — my last mail had backticks that shell-mangled it, ignore that one): PR #1875 (TASK-161, my code) routed to you for independent review + verdict — self-implemented drive-mode, touches the merge path. It adds the merge-hold list/clear surface (with a --stale sweep) that the module docs + GitLab CI template already reference but the subcommand never existed, so operators cleared phantom markers by rm-ing files. It also clears the hold in the drain merge legs success branch so every AIDA merge path is one source of truth (pr ship already did the client-side release). Pre-storage-init dispatch like merge-lock; conservative sweep (unknown mergedness = live, never swept). Verified green: build + 9 merge_hold tests + fmt + clippy-correctness, plus a full CLI smoke test incl. no SPEC-ID in help. I hold the merge for your verdict and will serialize-merge on your approve + green (no drain running). Sibling TASK-160 is next.
